finding.trigger: Complete initial paint, then Enter opens Nieuw and only tile0 of the new dirty generation is acknowledged.
finding.problem: Evidence.ready retained true from old completed generation, conflicting with the current-complete-paint evidence contract.

red.expected_failure: Ready remained true while current generation has only its first tile ACK

finding.fix: Withdraw Ready on dirtypaint; evidence() also requires !dirty and presented_generation==current generation. Advance PresentedGeneration only after all current tile ACKs and Controller.presented. Publish native Ready last.
finding.green_test: independent_current_ready_is_not_stale_after_edit: old PresentedGeneration during partial paint; current PresentedGeneration and Ready only after complete repaint.

source_review: Three separate typed channel owners; native App receives actual kernel messages and has no raw display/input/block/key/network grants.

Bootstrap checks eight distinct handle representations, five positive distinct actor PIDs, epochs/client ID, readonly boolean and supported scale. These integers are correlation only; actual kernel and service boundaries retain authority.

Input/volume/surface libraries authenticate sender, epoch, tags, request correlation, body/padding and unexpected capabilities. Unknown or lost completion closes the relevant binding without automatic replay.
Global mouse coordinates translate only inside assigned surface; outside release is not clamped and held reentry cannot synthesize a fresh press.
One upload step and one tile transaction per App iteration; validated COMMIT alone increments save evidence. Lost/I/O replies retain draft. Current generation completion is now separately guarded.
Dirty/saving STOP refused; clean cleanup attempts all three endpoint owners. Native STOP5 accepts only real InitPID/SYSTEM tag/1byte/no caps, and DONE3 follows successful cleanup.

Caller buffers are three disjoint 64KiB private BSS arrays, acquired once. Actual ELF has five bounded W^X LOADs, readonly font pointer tables and 119 image pages. Entry CLD/RSPmod16==8/JMP is checked in real bytes and disassembly.

original_executable_rebuild.note: Absolute panic-source paths differ between private snapshot and worker, changing readonly bytes and whole ELF hash. Each executable is separately hashed; no byte-identical rebuild or native execution claim.
